arguments.title: Wes’s first solo overnight — coaching note
arguments.body:
[2028-01-01]

Wes handled his first real solo overnight (June 21, 2023) well. He worked through a minor metrics-router cardinality issue, brought me in as secondary at about 40 minutes when he was uncertain, and resolved it cleanly without escalation. Hema’s assessment was measured but positive: this was good evidence of growth and the right judgment about when to ask for help—not enough to overstate on the basis of one shift. Keep reinforcing that timely, proportionate escalation is sound operational judgment.
